rationale: PINS the indexing uses contract. KAD1 (M37 kotlin wave): assignment-LHS indexing is a WRITE — `xs[i] = 42` emitted a bogus uses edge for the receiver pre-fix (java gates array writes by span; kotlin had no gate; oracle derives no kotlin uses truth, so F5 could not see it). `=` and `op=` both parse as `assignment` with the LHS as first named child; the gate is span-based. The read shape (`val v = xs[i]`) still emits uses.

expectRelationships.comment: KAD1: reads still emit — indexing is a read of the array reference

forbidRelationships.comment: KAD1: assignment-LHS indexing is a WRITE — must never emit a uses edge (pre-fix leaked it)
